body: Symptom: SidebarResizer drag was 'random / not working at all' — moved 1px then froze. Cause: pointermove/up handlers wrapped in useCallback against the setWidth prop, and useEffect cleanup tied to that callback identity. Parent App passed setWidth as inline arrow → new ref every render. Drag → setState → App re-renders → callback identity changes → useEffect cleanup fires → listeners removed MID-DRAG. chrome-ext's identical pattern worked only because its setSidebarWidth came from zustand (stable ref). Fix: install pointermove/up listeners ONCE on mount, read latest setter through a useRef refreshed each render, teardown only on real unmount. Apply this pattern to ANY React drag handler that calls setState during the drag (resizers, sliders, tab reorder, splitters). Build + tsc clean; runtime drag must be confirmed on a real display.
title: React drag handlers die mid-drag when parent passes inline callback + useCallback/useEffect cleanup loop
